verdict.rationale: Data residency and region choice is a fair question for a document-handling SaaS like Beglaubigt.de, but nothing in the evidence pack covers where data is stored or any user choice of region. The service's German focus (incorporation, ELSTER filing) is about the jurisdiction of the legal services, not a storage-region control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
